source_paper_text:
List every positive divisor of n increasingly as d1,...,d_tau. Set E(n)=sum of even-indexed divisors and O(n)=sum of odd-indexed divisors. Its index ratio is E(n)/O(n). For each positive rational k, G_k={n>=1:E(n)/O(n)=k}. Conjecture 13 asserts |G_k|<=1 whenever 0<k<1.

Conjecture 13 (faithful mathematical restatement): For 0<k<1, there is at most one positive integer n having index ratio k.

title: Index-ratio uniqueness below one
